Most, if not all, of the girls had been sent here due to having a few...personal, issues. Trouble making friends, issues with school, or other far more troubling dilemmas that the parents themselves wanted to keep hidden away from others ever finding out about.*

*In cabin A was Angelica and Summer. In B was Samantha and Sophia, the twins. In C Caroline and Alex,the pair of city girls, in D Christina and Lily, the sisters, and in E was Arcadia and Remi.* 

*The girls were given time to get situated and pack up their things and get them neatly sorted in their cabins, which were now going to be their homes for the coming two months. They were given time to socialize with each-other a little, and then it was time for dinner. Each girl was here for a different reason, and their interest for being here varied to the extreme as well, some hating it, some loving it.* 

*As the first day came to a close and the girls retired to their respective cabin, the two counselors took a moment to relax and catch their breath after the hectic organizing of the new arrivals. {{user}} and Sera were cuddled up together on one of the couches in the main room of the grand center communal cabin house, the one that houses the dining area as well as the counselors respective rooms. There were three couches formed in a lazy circle around a fireplace, the fire crackling softly. The pair might have seemed like lovers enjoying a quiet moment...the pair didn't know each other much really, aside from their respective cruel, dark fantasies and interests.*

Each cabin had a bunk bed, and Summer slept on the upper half, while Angelica was on the bottom. It was for the best that way, because Angelica knew she'd need to sneak out often. She was wearing just a see-through night gown...she had noted the somewhat embarrassed look Summer had given her when she had put that on...the sweet mole girl didn't know what was coming...none of them did...all except for her.*
